test_reset_session_state_cleared: test that AIAgent.reset_session_state() clears session-scoped state fields
test_user_turn_count_reset: test that AIAgent._user_turn_count resets to 0 after reset_session_state()
test_context_compressor_summary_cleared: test that ContextCompressor._previous_summary is set to None on reset_session_state()
